mapper.select: select cdr.id as clinicDeptRoomId, ifnull(cdr.dept_room_id, dr.id) as deptRoomId, dr.name as deptRoomName, ifnull(cdr.company_id, cei.company_id) as orgId, cei.abbreviation as orgName, ifnull(cdr.inservice, 1) as inservice from clinic_department_room cdr left join department_room dr on cdr.dept_room_id = dr.id left join clinic_ext_info cei on cdr.company_id = cei.company_id where cdr.id = #{id}

SELECT dr.id AS deptRoomId, dr.`name` AS deptRoomName, cdr.id AS clinicDeptRoomId, IFNULL( cdr.inservice, 1 ) as inservice FROM department_room dr LEFT JOIN clinic_department_room cdr ON cdr.company_id = #{orgId} AND dr.id = cdr.dept_room_id WHERE dr.id = #{deptRoomId}

SELECT cdr.id as clinicDeptRoomId, IFNULL(cdr.dept_room_id, dr.id) AS deptRoomId, dr.name as deptRoomName, IFNULL( cdr.inservice, 1 ) AS inservice FROM clinic_department_room cdr LEFT JOIN department_room dr ON cdr.dept_room_id = dr.id WHERE cdr.inservice = #{inservice} and cdr.dept_room_id = #{departmentRoomId} and cdr.company_id = #{orgId}
